plain_english_revision: The amendment allows government entities to temporarily move or protect historical monuments during emergency repairs or construction projects. This exception applies without needing a special waiver, provided the monument is returned to its original location and condition within 120 days after work finishes (or sooner if safe). If repairs are expected to take longer than 120 days, officials must follow the standard waiver process.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment advances a policy exception that permits temporary relocation of monuments for emergency repairs or construction without requiring an immediate waiver, ensuring they are restored within 120 days.
evidence_quotes: (3) In the event there is a need for emergency repairs or construction at the monument or on adjacent property, a controlling entity may temporarily relocate or otherwise protect the monument without seeking a waiver under the process set out in this section
